faq_seccion.descripcion: Everything you need to know before skiing the giant sand dunes of Huacachina.
faq_seccion.visual_titulo: First time trying SandSki or Sandboard?
faq_seccion.visual_desc: Our certified local instructors guide you on every single slope.

faqs.pregunta: 1. Is prior experience required for SandSki or Pro Sandboard?
faqs.respuesta: No. 80% of our guests have never skied or snowboarded before. We start on gentle dunes and our certified guides teach you balance step by step.

faqs.pregunta: 2. Do you have boots in my shoe size?
faqs.respuesta: Yes, at our Hospedaje Hawka base we stock over 50 pairs of real snow boots from size EU 35 to 45 for kids and adults.

faqs.pregunta: 3. Does the tour include 4x4 dune buggy transport to the top?
faqs.respuesta: Yes, all our packages include 4x4 buggy transport to the highest dunes and strategic stops for sunset photography.

faqs.pregunta: 4. Where can I store my luggage during the tour?
faqs.respuesta: At our main office at Av. Ángela Perotti S/n (Hospedaje Hawka Reception) we provide free individual lockers with keys.
